title: Strong Lefschetz Property of the Zeroth Jordan Component
statement: For an Artinian Gorenstein algebra $A$ and the component $Q(0)$ of its Jordan decomposition, can $A$ have the strong Lefschetz property while $Q(0)$ does not?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Lefschetz Properties in Algebra, Geometry and Combinatorics (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2020/31, pp. 1539--1600](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2020/31)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-22)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** General Jordan-type and central-simple-module theory gives criteria for strong Lefschetzness, but does not settle whether A can be strong Lefschetz while Q(0) is not.

**Sources checked.**

- [Harima--Watanabe, Central Simple Modules](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jpaa.2006.10.016)
